subject: EM iteration history for individual model params?

messages.author: 5df094e802c6f72d
messages.subject: EM iteration history for individual model params?
parts:
Hi everyone! I am teaching an IRT class this semester using mirt. One of the topics I want to teach about is diagnosing convergence issues. I can access the iteration history using attr(mirt.mod, "Internals")$collectLL . I am wondering if it is also possible to access the iteration history for the individual model parameters, or if anyone has any suggestions for how to do that?  

Any suggestions related to this idea would also be appreciated! Thanks, Peter

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: EM iteration history for individual model params?
parts:
Hi Peter,

There's an undocumented 'storeEMhistory' options to the technical list which allows the EM history to be stored and extracted via extract.mirt(). See below

####
library(mirt)
mod <- mirt(Science, technical = list(storeEMhistory = TRUE))
extract.mirt(mod, 'EMhistory')
###

For the most part I don't see why users would necessarily need this as it mainly increases the size of the final object, but if the purpose is purely for pedagogy then I see no harm. HTH

Phil
